_comment: Shared by player/mannequin/zombie — vanilla HumanoidModel.createMesh(CubeDeformation.NONE, 0.0F) box values, resources/minecraft-code/net/minecraft/client/model/HumanoidModel.java. Box space: Y-down, 16 units/block, y=0 at the neck/shoulder line, origin+size are addBox(x,y,z,w,h,d), uv is texOffs(u,v), pivot is PartPose.offset. See EntityJsonModel.hpp for how this gets converted to world-local space.
